text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon gallops as if flying!
Just like dancing upon a stage.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —However!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaah!!" his

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The champion Furioso won't back down, won't give an inch!
Taking on the powerhouse of the JRA, ready to give them a lesson!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Upon these shoulders rests the fate of Funabashi!
The future is riding on me!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (To protect and nurture the town where the people I love live—!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'm gonna—looose!!
Graaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Furi-chaaaan!!!!!
Go for it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Wiiiiin!!!!!
Blow them all awaaayyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Screams filled the air. Everyone in Funabashi was crying.
Naturally, I was too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"About three years have passed since the day Furioso decided
on her special study-abroad program and arrived at the Central. She—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
You did it, Furioso!
Funabashi's Commander-in-Chief stands tall and proud in his hometown!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: She has brilliantly repelled Smart Falcon's challenge!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Furioso-san...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Falcon-san.
You are... strong.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"She will surely grow even stronger from now on.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We... cannot afford to lose.
We have a reason why we must not lose.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Please come back to Funabashi.
I'll accept your challenge as many times as it takes."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
As a powerhouse of the regionals, I shall take on all challenges.
That is my pride, and—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: It's my gratitude to Central.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso now stood at the culmination of a bitter feud.
At the end of a long, arduous war between Funabashi and the JRA.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing there against the crimson sunset...
she had changed so much since the day we first met.
choice_data_list: Splendid... You are my true pride...
Splendid... You are my true pride...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"If I hadn't... met you in this place...
I wouldn't have made it this far..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't come to the Chuoh with me...
I would have given up long ago...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"This is a victory for the two of us, you and me.
We are... forever as one..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "Let us continue to watch over Funabashi together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume and Trainer from the same hometown.
That is precisely why there are things only they can do.
Why there is a future only they can create.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To everyone in Funabashi who cheered for me,
and to all the many guests who came today――

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Thank you so very much!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I felt that I absolutely could not lose.
Chuoh is strong. In terms of overall power, they're above Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"However, just as I was able to win today,
Funabashi is full of potential!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi, growing stronger by the day.
It is a city overflowing with charm. First of all—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi Racecourse holds night races on weekdays too.
You can enjoy them even on your way home from work.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
There is also a large shopping mall nearby.
You can eat and shop there
before and after watching the races.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "Please come see us as we diligently hone our skills every day. All of us are waiting for you."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: And finally—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please cherish
the town where you were born and raised!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Grand stages aren't the only utopias.
A utopia is—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's the place you can love the most!
Small—can conquer big!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many align themselves with the powerful.
Yet, there are proud souls
who refuse to do so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Staying true to her unwavering love for her hometown,
Furioso carved the hoofprints of a champion
into the place she loved most.
